This diverse group of technology experts collaborates on cutting-edge solutions that propel our business’s mission forward. Explore open roles Teams Engineering Our engineering team is the powerhouse behind Navan’s innovative solutions. It brings together front-end, back end, full-stack, and mobile developers, along with specialized teams focused on our expense, travel, growth, and AI lines of business. Together, they create seamless, scalable, and cutting-edge technologies that drive the future of business travel and expense management. Product The product team drives the vision and strategy for our expense, travel, and growth teams, along with a team dedicated to AI initiatives. The product team bridges the gap between customer needs and technical solutions, so that every feature and service is intuitive, impactful, and aligned with Navan’s mission to transform business travel and expense management. Design The design team shapes the user experience. It plays a leading role in crafting intuitive, visually engaging, and user-centric designs that enhance customers' interactions with Navan’s products so that every touchpoint is seamless and delightful. Business Technology The business technology team drives the innovation and efficiency of our internal operations through business systems and IT. This team constantly iterates on and improves the seamless integration of tools, systems, and technologies that empower our employees to work smarter. They’re responsible for optimizing processes across the company to support Navan’s rapid growth. Security The security team is dedicated to safeguarding Navan’s systems, data, and customers by implementing cutting-edge security protocols and guaranteeing compliance. The security team plays an integral role in protecting the integrity of the Navan platform, proactively mitigating risks, and fostering a secure environment where innovation and growth thrive. Data The data team plays a key role in transforming information into actionable insights that shape business decisions and drive innovation. Using a cutting-edge data stack and advanced analytics, the team guarantees that accurate, reliable data is readily available across the organization. By harnessing the power of machine learning, they also create state-of-the-art data products that empower our customers and elevate their experience.
